title: Resumes Management Platform
description: Full-stack resumes management application with CRUD operations.
prompt:
Build an ATS Resume Optimizer web application where users upload a resume (PDF/DOCX) and paste a job description.
Extract and analyze resume content, compare it with the job description, and calculate an ATS compatibility score.
Identify missing keywords, skills, experience gaps, formatting issues, and provide actionable optimization suggestions.
Add a polished responsive UI with Resume Upload, Job Description, ATS Score, Keyword Analysis, Suggestions, and Optimized Resume sections.
Implement the complete frontend, backend, database/API integration, validation, error handling, and tests—no static/mock functionality.
